# Command-line reference

## `ariane`

```text
usage: ariane [-h] [--version]
              {start,update,status,next,report,verify,judge} ...

Turn tickets into reviewed pull requests.

positional arguments:
  {start,update,status,next,report,verify,judge}
    start               run the ticket of an issue up to its pull request
    update              merge the base branch into a delivered ticket's
                        branch, replay, review, push on go
    status              show a ticket's state, read from its folder
    next                propose the next ticket of the queue that can start
                        next to the running ones
    report              show cost, agent time, human time, gates bypassed,
                        shadow results
    verify              check and review a local branch finished by hand, then
                        record it on the branch
    judge               record your verdict and time on a shadow ticket

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `ariane start`

```text
usage: ariane start [-h] [--log-level LEVEL] [--shadow] [--restart] issue

positional arguments:
  issue              issue number

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --log-level LEVEL  technical log level: debug, info, warning or error
                     (default: ARIANE_LOG_LEVEL, else warning)
  --shadow           run the ticket in a separate clone, without push or pull
                     request
  --restart          start a stopped or interrupted ticket over: remove its
                     working trees and keep its branch as ariane-
                     restarted/<issue>-<time>
```

```text

positional arguments:
  issue              issue number

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --log-level LEVEL  technical log level: debug, info, warning or error
```

## `ariane next`

```text
usage: ariane next [-h] [--log-level LEVEL] [--start]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --log-level LEVEL  technical log level: debug, info, warning or error
                     (default: ARIANE_LOG_LEVEL, else warning)
  --start            start the proposal last printed, in the background, if it
                     has not changed
```

## `ariane report`

```text
usage: ariane report [-h] [--log-level LEVEL] [--since YYYY-MM-DD]

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --log-level LEVEL   technical log level: debug, info, warning or error
                      (default: ARIANE_LOG_LEVEL, else warning)
  --since YYYY-MM-DD  keep tickets started on or after this day (default: all)
```

## `ariane verify`

```text
usage: ariane verify [-h] [--log-level LEVEL] [--issue ISSUE] branch

positional arguments:
  branch             a branch that exists locally

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --log-level LEVEL  technical log level: debug, info, warning or error
                     (default: ARIANE_LOG_LEVEL, else warning)
  --issue ISSUE      give this issue's text to the reviewer (default: the
                     branch's commit messages)
```

## `ariane judge`

```text
usage: ariane judge [-h] [--log-level LEVEL] --minutes MINUTES [--note NOTE]
                    issue {accept,reject}

positional arguments:
  issue              issue number
  {accept,reject}    is the diff acceptable?

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --log-level LEVEL  technical log level: debug, info, warning or error
                     (default: ARIANE_LOG_LEVEL, else warning)
  --minutes MINUTES  human time spent on the ticket, 0 to 1440
  --note NOTE        free text kept with the verdict
```
